scientific_integrity: The previously derived finite mean identity and the 2012 heuristic time scale are credited, not claimed as new. No external or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary entrance Palm conditioning, iid uniform labels, deterministic sliding-window expiry, and fixed 0<alpha<1. The full Poisson and exponential weak limits follow analytically; finite enumeration alone proves no asymptotic theorem. An older general cluster-limit result could encompass these statements.
title: Poisson singleton clocks and exponential coverage episodes in expiring coupon collection
